meta.name: image-inpainting
meta.description: Mask-driven image inpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Tongyi MAI Z-Image Turbo Inpainting (the dedicated inpainting endpoint with mask, strength, and control-scale) and to identity-preserving edit models (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when a mask isn't available and the region must be described instead. Use for object removal, watermark removal, region replacement, blemish cleanup, and any controlled local edit where a binary mask defines the target area. Triggers on "inpaint", "inpainting", "image inpaint", "remove from image", "fill region", "mask-driven edit", "remove watermark", "remove object", "patch the photo", "fill the hole", or any explicit ask to edit a specific masked region of a still.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用遮罩精准编辑图片的指定区域
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在图片中精确移除或替换特定区域
copy.tagline_en: Edit specific image regions with mask-driven precision
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to precisely remove or replace specific areas in an image

howto.what: Claude 能根据你提供的图片和遮罩，移除或替换指定区域的内容，比如去掉水印、物体或填补空洞。如果没有遮罩，它也能通过文字描述来编辑图片。
howto.when: 当你提到“修复图片”、“去掉水印”、“移除物体”、“填充区域”等关键词时，Claude 会调用此技能。

say.text: 帮我把这张照片里的电线杆去掉。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供图片和遮罩，然后移除电线杆。

say.text: 去掉这张图右下角的水印。
say.note: 如果没有遮罩，Claude 会尝试用文字描述来编辑。

say.text: 把这张图片的背景换成纯色。
say.note: 需要提供背景区域的遮罩。

howto.what_en: Claude can remove or replace specific areas in an image using a mask, such as removing watermarks, objects, or filling holes. Without a mask, it can edit based on a text description.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when you mention keywords like "inpaint", "remove watermark", "remove object", "fill region", or any explicit request to edit a masked area.

say_en.text: Remove the power lines from this photo.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the image and mask, then remove the power lines.

say_en.text: Remove the watermark in the bottom-right corner.
say_en.note: Without a mask, Claude will try to edit using a description.

say_en.text: Replace the background with a solid color.
say_en.note: A mask for the background area is required.
